Staffing: Una, Greta, Ada, Kira out. Pia, Opal, Finn, Bram, Mira, Dell, Esme, Teo, Ines, Wren, Leon, Suri, Cora, Rafe, Nils, Jonah, Hugo, Vik covering. Jonah/Dell swap. Una/Finn swap. Ines/Vik swap. Opal/Hugo swap. Nils/Rafe swap. Cora/Suri swap. Esme/Teo swap.
Logistics: Print room (evening noise, repainted, afternoon noise, umbrella). Loading bay (evening noise, coffee machine, free afternoon, repainted, umbrella). East wing coffee machine; morning stand-up here. North office free morning (repainted, morning noise). Garden studio coffee machine; afternoon stand-up here. East wing too cold afternoon/evening; repainted, afternoon noise. Lifts near north office, library annex; print room slow. East wing lift slow. Umbrellas in north office/loading bay/east wing/garden studio/print room. Mira/Jonah think harbour room too cold. Library annex repainting; afternoon noise.
Preferences: Pia, Kira, Hugo want harbour room clear for visitors. Rafe wants print room clear. Ines wants library annex clear for visitors. Esme/Finn prefer loading bay for reviews. Bram/Leon prefer garden studio for reviews. Hugo prefers loading bay.
Actions: Send notes to Una, Wren, Dell (morning); Opal, Mira, Teo (afternoon); Cora, Ada, Pia, Opal (evening). Check Mira before evening meeting. Remind about Finn, Bram, Hugo, Leon preferences. Leon asked if library annex free afternoon.
New Info: Leon thinks print room too cold morning. Suri thinks garden studio too cold evening.
